## How it was checked

## Sign-off

Every commit carries `Signed-off-by: Your Name <you@example.com>` matching its
author (`git commit -s`): the [Developer Certificate of
Origin](https://developercertificate.org/). CI refuses a pull request with a
commit that lacks it. To add it: `git commit --amend -s` for the last commit,
`git rebase --signoff <base>` for several, then push again.
